info.title: Festival API
info.description: Festival API aggregates film festival data — submission deadlines, categories, genres, standard submission fees, submission platforms, past winners, programming rosters, and composite scoring — into a single JSON endpoint. Search, filter, and discover film festivals worldwide.

get.description: Unauthenticated endpoint that returns a simple OK payload.
Search and filter festivals. Returns paginated results with query, country, category, genre, deadline range, fee max, submission platform, and state filters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search by festival name or description.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Filter by country. Accepts full names or common codes, e.g. 'Australia'/'AU', 'Canada'/'CA', 'United States'/'US'.

parameters.name: deadline_before
parameters.description: Filter by regular deadline on or before this date.

parameters.name: deadline_after
parameters.description: Filter by regular deadline on or after this date.

parameters.name: event_date_before
parameters.description: Filter by event start date on or before this date.

parameters.name: fee_max
parameters.description: Maximum regular submission fee in USD.

get.description: Returns a full festival record including deadlines, fees, acceptance rate, past winners, programming directors, and composite score.

example.name: Sundance Film Festival
example.description: Premier independent film festival founded by Robert Redford.

get.description: Returns the programming roster (films screened) for a festival.
Returns festivals ranked by composite score. Supports page/per_page pagination (default: 20 results, max: 100).
Returns all festival categories with the count of active festivals in each.
Returns all countries with festival counts, ordered by count descending.

Describes what a festival actually programs, derived from its historical roster of screened/awarded films. Returns years analyzed, dominant categories, common award categories, programming trends, sample size, confidence, and last_verified_at. Honesty rule: only publishes analytics supported by the historical roster data.

notes: Profile derived from festival roster entries.

get.description: Upcoming festival event dates and submission deadlines in a date window, sorted by date. Supports ?format=ics for an .ics file.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: N days from today, alternative to start/end.

get.description: Festivals whose earliest upcoming submission deadline falls within the next N days.
Returns all states/provinces with festival counts, ordered by count descending. Supports optional country filter.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Filter by country. Accepts full names or common codes.

submission_categories.description: Category-specific submission options with paired deadline and fee data. Inferred entries are marked unverified.
